review_text: The Chickenjoy is always crispy and the gravy is unbeatable comfort food.
The Jolly Spaghetti was too sweet and the noodles were mushy.
Chicken Inasal is smoky and tender with unlimited rice, great value.
The halo-halo was mostly ice with barely any toppings.
Sisig here is creative and flavorful, loved the modern twist on classics.
The crispy kare-kare tasted bland and the peanut sauce was too thin.
The fried chicken is famous for a reason, super juicy and crispy skin.
The pork sinigang was too sour and the meat was tough.
Halo-halo and chao fan combo is a solid cheap meal, quick service too.
The lumpia shanghai was greasy and not as fresh as before.
Adobo flakes and kinilaw were bursting with flavor, best modern Filipino spot.
The bicol express was overly oily and too rich to finish.
Sizzling sisig and crispy pata were excellent, great for group dining.
The kare-kare sauce was watery and lacked the usual nutty flavor.
Silver Dollar pancakes with maple syrup never disappoint, classic comfort breakfast.
The waffles were undercooked and the coffee was lukewarm.
McDo's fries are always hot and crispy, quick and reliable service.
The Big Mac arrived cold and the order was wrong twice.
Original Recipe chicken is crispy and well seasoned as always.
The mashed potatoes tasted bland and the chicken was overly greasy.
ShackBurger is juicy with a great char, crinkle fries are addictive.
The milkshake was overpriced for the small size, though it tasted great.
Xiao long bao here has perfectly thin skin and rich broth, worth the wait.
The fried rice was underwhelming and overpriced for the portion.
The black cod miso was melt-in-your-mouth incredible, elegant fine dining experience.
The sushi platter was tiny for the steep price we paid.
Huge portions and the Oreo cheesecake is rich and creamy, great for sharing.
The chicken alfredo was overcooked and the sauce tasted watery.
Stuffed crust pizza is cheesy and satisfying, delivery was fast.
The pan pizza arrived cold and toppings were sparse.
Animal style fries and the double-double burger are absolute classics.
The animal style fries were soggy this time, though the burger was still good.
Unlimited breadsticks and the salad were comforting and generous.
The fettuccine alfredo was overcooked and the sauce tasted watery.
Beautiful garden setting and the tasting menu was refined and memorable.
The wine pairing options were limited and pricey for what's offered.
The mocha dream cake is rich and not overly sweet, perfect for celebrations.
The ube cake tasted artificial and the frosting was too sugary.
Polvoron here is buttery and melts in your mouth, a classic favorite.
The leche flan was too dense and lacked the usual creaminess.
The mango bravo cake is a must-try, light and refreshingly sweet.
Service was slow and the coffee tasted burnt.
Crispy pata and inihaw na liempo were amazing, great for pulutan nights.
The sisig was overly oily and lacked seasoning.
Kare-kare here is rich and authentic, best I've had in a while.
The crispy pata was too tough to cut through.
Endless variety of Kapampangan dishes, the sisig and bringhe are standouts.
Food was lukewarm since it sat out too long during the buffet.
Baby back ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender with a smoky glaze.
The pulled pork sandwich was dry and lacked sauce.
The New York style pizza has a great thin crust and generous toppings.
Delivery took over an hour and the pizza arrived cold.
The Hawaiian Overload pizza is cheesy and packed with toppings.
Crust was too doughy and undercooked in the center.
The Dirty Chori Burger is packed with flavor, messy but so good.
Burrito filling was skimpy for the price.
Krispy Krunchy Burger has a great crunch and juicy patty.
Fries were soggy and lukewarm when served.
The roasted chicken is moist and flavorful with great herb seasoning.
Side dishes were bland and portions felt smaller than before.
The caramel macchiato is smooth and perfectly balanced, my go-to order.
Barista got my order wrong and the line moved painfully slow.
The Original Glazed donut is soft, warm, and melts in your mouth.
Donuts felt stale and clearly not fresh out of the fryer.
The baked BBQ pork buns are flaky and sweetly savory, a Hong Kong classic done right.
Dumplings were cold by the time they reached our table.
The tonkatsu is crispy on the outside and juicy inside, comes with great sauces.
Rice was undercooked and the katsu was over-fried.
The Akamaru Modern ramen has a rich, deep pork broth, absolutely worth it.
Broth was lukewarm and noodles were overcooked and mushy.
The chewy udon noodles paired with tempura are always a satisfying combo.
Tempura was greasy and the batter fell apart.
The soy garlic fried chicken is crispy and packed with flavor.
Chicken was overly salty and the fries were cold.
The sizzling beef pepper rice is fun to mix and tastes great fresh off the plate.
Beef was tougher than expected and lacked seasoning.
The Baconator is hearty and packed with flavor, one of the best fast food burgers.
Fries were cold and the burger patty was overcooked.
The Whopper has a great flame-grilled taste that stands out from other burgers.
Burger arrived squished and the bun was stale.
The Louisiana fried chicken is crispy, spicy, and packed with flavor.
Chicken was overly greasy and biscuits were dry.
The honey butter biscuit paired with fried chicken is a fantastic combo.
Chicken was underseasoned and the coleslaw was watery.
Endless seafood on ice and the sashimi selection make this buffet worth every peso.
Some stations ran out of food quickly during peak hours.
